name: Dedericus IV
source_profile:
King Dedericus IV, House Cadewyn — The Falcon of Cade 
House Cadewyn is the royal dynasty of Cador, claiming descent from the monarchs who first 
united the kingdom's disparate lordships. Its ancestral holdings comprise the Duchy of Cade, 
the political heartland of southern Cador and the seat of the royal court. The current king 
inherited a kingdom torn apart by a civil war largely precipitated by the policies of his father, 
King Dedericus III, the Unbending, a.k.a. the Sundering King. His swift conclusion of the fighting 
and subsequent efforts at reconciliation have earned him considerable popularity, although his 
consolidation of royal authority has made some nobles uneasy. 
 
Political tension: The king's willingness to recognize loyal northern houses has angered 
certain southern aristocrats who supported his father's restrictions on noble birthright. The 
creation of four new marquisates has also disturbed the established balance between the old 
Great Lords.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 9–9 (source excerpt)
